            if ((b & 1) != 0) {
                res = (res * a) % MOD;
            }
            a = (a * a) % MOD;
            b >>= 1;
        }
        return res;

    static long go(long n, int kind) {
        long key = n * 2 + kind;
        Long cached = memo.get(key);
        if (cached != null) {
            return cached;
        }

        long ans;
        if (kind == 0) {
            if (n == 1) {
                ans = even;
            } else if (n == 2) {
                ans = (even * even + odd * odd) % MOD;
            } else {
                long left = n / 2;
                long right = n - left;
                long a0 = go(left, 0);
                long a1 = go(right, 0);
                long b0 = go(left, 1);
                long b1 = go(right, 1);
                ans = (a0 * a1 + b0 * b1) % MOD;
            }
        } else {
            if (n == 1) {
                ans = odd;

                long b0 = go(left, 1);
                long b1 = go(right, 0);
                ans = (a0 * a1 + b0 * b1) % MOD;
            }
        }

        memo.put(key, ans);
